name: Better Lock
author: Bibek Bhusal
description: Quickshell session lock clone with date/time, weather, power controls, a now-playing card with music aura, a music screensaver and a now-playing pill.

schema.label: Time format
schema.description: Format string for lock screen time text

schema.label: Date format
schema.description: Format string for lock screen date text

schema.label: Aura style
schema.description: Music aura style: horizon, halo, spectrum, cloud or orbs

schema.label: Music screensaver
schema.description: Show the cover/aura screensaver after shell.json idle.screensaver seconds (replaces Omarchy's terminal screensaver)

schema.label: Now playing pill
schema.description: Show a pill under the bar when the track changes
